connectors.name: Bottom-left 4 pogo pads
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers and no identifiable USB connector; horizontal row ordered left to right

connectors.name: Bottom-right 4 pogo pads
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers and no identifiable USB connector; horizontal row ordered left to right

uncertain: A slot-shaped opening at the bottom center between the two pad groups may be a USB-C port, but it is not labeled. If it is USB, rule 4 would start the left group at its right end (G18) and the right group at its left end (5V); left-to-right order was used for both.
notes: Labels read from the callout bars below the device; the two callout groups are linked to the two 4-pad groups by shaded leader shapes.
